heart_demon_backlash: A 心魔 (Heart Demon) stirs within {name}, cackling from the shadows of their own soul. Karma curdles, and the breakthrough curdles with it.
In the instant of failure, {name} sees their own face — smiling cruelly. The Heart Demon has tasted blood, and it wants more.
{name}'s cultivation backfires; a tendril of black smoke coils from their shadow. The Heart Demon grows stronger by the failure.
The demon within whispers every sin {name} ever buried. One lands — and the dantian twists, realm sub-stages falling away.
Karma, dark and heavy, drags at {name}'s spirit as the Heart Demon feasts. 50 points of 业力 (karma) are scorched away.
Somewhere, a rival cultivator laughs. {name} hears it across ten thousand miles — the Heart Demon made sure they would.
The failure plants a seed of doubt, and doubt is the Heart Demon's native soil. {name} feels the realm shudder.
A ghostly mirror appears before {name}: in it, a version of themself who never failed. The Heart Demon holds the mirror. It smiles.
